properties.name: Al Manāmah
properties.note: Capital governorate, drawn with its pre-2014 extent. The governorate is larger today (38 square km in 2012, 78 in 2015 in the official area series), so a place in today's Capital governorate may lie outside this shape.

properties.name: Al Janūbīyah
properties.note: Southern governorate, drawn as Natural Earth has it, from before the 2014 redivision; whether its extent changed then was not verified. Includes the Hawar Islands as Natural Earth draws them.

properties.name: Al Wusţá
properties.note: Central governorate: abolished in 2014, when the governorates were redivided into four (Survey and Land Registration Bureau, Area by Governorate). Drawn because Natural Earth still carries it; never assigned an event and never given an event count. An event that a source locates in this area is recorded at country level, not moved to a neighbouring unit.

properties.name: Ash Shamālīyah
properties.note: Northern governorate, drawn as Natural Earth has it, from before the 2014 redivision; whether its extent changed then was not verified.
